auth.loggingInApp: Complete sign-in in the window that opened…
auth.manualHint: Log in on soundcloud.com → F12 → Storage (Firefox) or Application (Chrome) → Cookies → soundcloud.com → copy the oauth_token value
auth.sessionExpired: Your session expired — SoundCloud no longer accepts the stored token. Sign in again.
auth.offline: No connection to SoundCloud — you are still signed in.

offline.why: The app could not reach SoundCloud. Check your internet.

rateLimited.what: SoundCloud is asking us to slow down.
rateLimited.why: Too many requests in a short time. Wait a minute.

sessionExpired.why: SoundCloud no longer accepts the saved sign-in.

botFiltered.why: It wants proof you are a person. Open soundcloud.com in your browser, then try again.

noStream.why: SoundCloud is not giving out a sound file for it.

notDownloadable.why: SoundCloud offers it only as a stream.

disk.what: The file could not be written.
disk.why: Check there is free space and that the folder can be written to.

badLink.what: That link is not a SoundCloud link.

refused.why: Usually temporary — trying again often works.

loginTimeout.why: The app waited three minutes and saw no sign-in.

tagging.what: Downloaded, but the file carries no track info.
tagging.why: The audio is fine; the title and cover could not be written into it.

localLibrary.what: The local library did not answer.
localLibrary.why: Restarting the app usually fixes it.

keyring.what: The system password store is out of reach.
keyring.why: That is where your sign-in is kept.

home.emptyHint: Everything you listen to will show up here

library.stationsHint: An endless stream seeded by a track or an artist

search.hint: Type a query to start searching
search.pasteHint: Paste a SoundCloud link to open it

player.visualizerBlocked: The visualiser can't read this track — its host doesn't allow it. Sound is unaffected.
player.localFileBroken: The downloaded file won't decode — streaming instead
player.offlineOnlyBlocked: Offline mode is on and this track isn't downloaded

settings.layoutHint: How navigation and content are arranged
settings.layoutSkinLimited: {skin} is drawn for two of these

skinHints.one: One typeface, soft corners, quiet depth
skinHints.nit: Two inks, square cards, round controls
skinHints.editorial: Large type, hard lines, no shadows
skinHints.studio: Tactile controls, careful depth, a waveform

settings.accentHint: Applied on top of the palette
settings.backdropHint: Your own image, or the playing cover
settings.autoplayNextHint: Start the next queued track when the current one ends
settings.rememberVolumeHint: Restore the last volume on start
settings.presetsHint: Save the current look, or move it to another machine
settings.imageTooLarge: Image is over 4 MB — pick a smaller file
settings.importFailed: Could not read that theme file
settings.glassAppleLocked: Always on in Apple mode — Liquid Glass is what the look is made of
settings.glassPerf: Costly to render — turn it off if the UI feels sluggish
settings.monoArtworkHint: Nit prints covers in two inks; Obsidian drains them to grey. The other skins leave them alone.
settings.printShiftHint: Screen headings print twice, the second impression out of register
settings.nitHint: Twelve things the app does that are nobody else's. All of them local, all of them switchable.
settings.loudnessHint: Measure what plays and trim the next play of it. The first play of a track is never touched.
settings.nightHint: Squeeze the dynamics so the quiet parts stay audible and the loud parts stay polite
settings.resumeHint: Reopen with the same queue and position. Paused — nothing starts playing on its own.
settings.builtinHint: Skin, palette and wallpaper in one tap. Every switch stays yours afterwards.

presetHints.builtin:nit: The app as it ships: soot, bone, ultramarine and sulphur
presetHints.builtin:apple: iOS 26: Liquid Glass, floating chrome, San Francisco

settings.customHint: Override the palette; clear them next to it
settings.effectsHint: Falling particles over the whole window. Animated, so it costs frames — off by default.
settings.offlineHint: A downloaded track always plays from disk — cover included. This is for when you want nothing else to reach the network at all.
settings.offlineOnlyHint: Play only what is downloaded. Nothing streams, no covers or lyrics are fetched.

lyrics.none: No lyrics — normal for remixes, sets and edits
lyrics.failed: Could not reach the lyrics service
lyrics.offline: Lyrics aren't fetched in offline mode

downloads.title: Downloads
downloads.hint: Downloaded tracks play with no connection

audio.title: Sound
audio.fadeHint: Fade out and in when the track changes
audio.radioHint: Keep playing related tracks once the queue runs out
audio.warn: If sound disappears, turn the equaliser off and replay the track
audio.visualizerHint: Spectrum in the full-screen player. Routes audio through processing, so the track reloads
audio.diagnosticsHint: What the audio engine is doing right now — useful when a track plays with no sound
audio.graphUnsupported: This webview can't route audio through effects — the equaliser and visualiser are off. Sound is unaffected.

keys.title: Keyboard shortcuts
keys.hint: Inactive while a text field has focus. And yes, there is one more code hidden here.

trackPage.downloadFailed: The uploader has not enabled downloads

messages.title: Messages
messages.hint: Open someone's profile and press Message to start one.

marks.title: Marks
marks.notePlaceholder: Bass drop, what is this sample…
marks.empty: Nothing yet. Set the first mark — press M while a track plays.
marks.hint: Places you saved inside a track — a moment, and a note if you left one.
marks.emptyTrack: No marks on this track yet. Press M.

thread.title: Thread
thread.noWaveform: SoundCloud did not send a waveform. Showing the default shape; seeking works.

cmdk.placeholder: Type a command, a track, a mark…
cmdk.hintKeys: ↑↓ to move · ↵ to run · esc to close

trap.title: Link trap
trap.hint: When you copy a SoundCloud link somewhere else, the app offers to take it. Off until you say otherwise.
trap.consent: The clipboard is read only while this window has focus, only right after it gains focus, and only to check whether what is in it is a soundcloud.com link. Nothing is stored and nothing is logged.
trap.found: A SoundCloud link is on your clipboard
trap.unavailable: This build cannot read the clipboard

later.title: Later
later.hint: Not likes — things to hear when there is time.
later.empty: Nothing saved. Anything you mean to hear later goes here.

diary.title: Diary
diary.hint: What played, when. Local, and it never leaves this machine.
diary.empty: Nothing here yet — it fills as you listen.

dupes.title: Duplicates
dupes.hint: The same upload sitting in your likes more than once.
dupes.hiddenHint: Hidden here only. Nothing was unliked on SoundCloud.

gone.about: Tracks that vanished from SoundCloud. What the app saw of them is still here.
gone.hint: The upload is no longer on SoundCloud. This is the last thing the app saw of it.

hud.title: Overlay
hud.hint: A one-second glance at what is playing, over whatever you are doing.

shortcuts.title: Global shortcuts
shortcuts.hint: Work while another window has focus.
shortcuts.conflict: {key} is taken by something else on this system
shortcuts.waylandWarning: On Wayland, global shortcuts often cannot be registered by an application at all. If nothing happens, bind them in your desktop's own settings instead.

storage.title: What is kept locally
storage.hint: This app is unofficial and talks to an undocumented API. The least it can do is be plain about what it keeps.
storage.nothingLeaves: None of this is ever sent anywhere.
